reviews.title: Ridiculous scammers
reviews.text: Not usually a person to write bad reviews but I paid for this on my android phone and recently switched over to iPhone. I have sent a support email saying I can’t get into the same account and they said that the android and Apple version are different apps when the most clearly Not this is ridiculous Hope this changes.

reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text:
Switched from android to iPhone then they tell me: Sorry for the inconvenience caused.

We would like to kindly tell you that Android version and iOS version are independent and the data and payment can't be shared between the two platforms currently.

Thanks for bringing this issue to our attention. We greatly appreciate your understanding and patience in this matter.

(((After receiving a response to my review, I’m gonna say again, I asked for support they told me that the app doesn’t work across platforms and asked if I would submit a request for assistance, what was my first request, if the response was reach out to the developer for support. Reiterating ONE STAR!!!!! *)))

reviews.title: Push up city!!!
reviews.text: The app is designed well and the layout and navigation through is excellent but there is waaaaaaay to many push ups that I’ve already lost interest on day 5. Would only recommend to someone who likes an excessive amount of push ups, every.single. workout. Shame, as it could be so much better with a bit of creativity
